cell.label: Patient diagnosed clinically with hyphema: (1) History for trauma, any bleeding risks, and sickle cell disease; (2) Thorough evaluation for other injuries of globe and orbit (typically slit lamp examination ± CT of orbit); (3) Grade severity of hyphema ()
Grade I hyphema, no associated injury?
Grade II or III hyphema, minor or no associated injury?
Eye protection with shield, cycloplegic drops ± steroid, sleep with head of bed elevated. Activity: Quiet ambulation, prompt referral for daily follow-up examinations.
Probable initial hospitalization. Discuss with consultant.
Severe ocular or bony injury, Grade IV hyphema, sickle cell trait or disease.
